title: Cam Pattern Record
description: Documentation-only schema for a single typed pattern record (src/patterns/record.ts). Not runtime-loaded: validation at runtime is the hand-rolled isPatternRecord guard (ADR-0038), not this file.

classification.description: Confidence/authority tier, orthogonal to the record's accumulated outcome history.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the record was first written.

name.description: Short identifying name for the pattern.

dir_anchors.description: Directories/paths this record is scoped to, letting grep-on-demand filter records by subsystem.

outcomes.description: History of outcomes recorded each time the pattern is applied. Feeds confirmationScore and the decay/demotion gate (cam patterns prune).
